top_signals.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
top_signals.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Yuki Tsunoda happy to cut beach vacation short to race at Dutch Grand Prix
top_signals.summary: The reserve driver, who lost his race seat last season, was called up after Red Bull regular Isack Hadjar injured his wrist in training.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Japan executes 58-year-old man convicted of killing five in 2009 Osaka pachinko parlor arson
top_signals.summary: The death row convict was executed Friday morning, according to media reports.
